نضطبن (form VIII)
# نَضْطَبِنُ (naḍṭabinu) /nadˤ.tˤa.bi.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# نُضْطَبَنُ (nuḍṭabanu) /nudˤ.tˤa.ba.nu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# نَضْطَبِنَ (naḍṭabina) /nadˤ.tˤa.bi.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# نُضْطَبَنَ (nuḍṭabana) /nudˤ.tˤa.
